newsitem.title: USA: Italian financier suspected of fleeing sentencing.
newsitem.headline: Italian financier suspected of fleeing sentencing.

text.p: An arrest warrant was issued on Friday for the former chief of the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer movie studio after the Italian financier apparently fled the United States to avoid a court sentence, his attorney said.

Attorney Eugene Maurer said he had received a fax on Friday from a lawyer in Italy saying he was acting on behalf of the financier, Giancarlo Parretti. "It seems as if he (Parretti) is gone," Maurer told Reuters.
Parretti was due to be sentenced on Monday after being found guilty in a Delaware state court on October 2 on charges of evidence tampering and perjury.

He had returned voluntarily from Italy to face trial and had been free on bail and living in California. Maurer said Parretti, if he had fled, would forfeit bonds in Delaware and California totalling $125,000.
Maurer said Delaware Superior Court Judge Richard Cooch issued the warrant after a meeting Friday with Maurer and state prosecutor Paul Wallace.
Wallace could not be reached for comment.
